import { createContextKey, declareExtern, definePrototype } from '@proto.ui/core/authoring';

export const POLICY_ZONE = createContextKey<string>('policy-zone');

const loadItem = declareExtern<[id: string], string>({
  name: 'fixture.load-keyed-item',
  effect: 'after-state-commit',
  lifetime: 'task',
  async: true,
  targets: ['react', 'gpui'],
});

function append(log: string, id: string, start: string, end: string, text: string): string {
  return log + id + '@' + start + '>' + end + '=' + text + ';';
}

export default definePrototype({
  name: 'policy-reader',
  setup(def) {
    const zone = def.context.consume(POLICY_ZONE);
    const orderedLog = def.state.define<string>('orderedLog', { initialize: () => '' });
    const parallelLog = def.state.define<string>('parallelLog', { initialize: () => '' });
    const ordered = def.task<[id: string], void>('ordered', { policy: 'serial' }, async (task, id) => {
      const start = task.get(zone);
      const text = await task.await(loadItem, id);
      task.set(orderedLog, append(task.get(orderedLog), id, start, task.get(zone), text));
    });
    const concurrent = def.task<[id: string], void>('concurrent', { policy: 'parallel' }, async (task, id) => {
      const start = task.get(zone);
      const text = await task.await(loadItem, id);
      task.set(parallelLog, append(task.get(parallelLog), id, start, task.get(zone), text));
    });
    const queue = def.action<[id: string], void>('queue', (run, id) => { run.start(ordered, id); });
    const submit = def.action<[id: string], void>('submit', (run, id) => { run.start(concurrent, id); });
    def.expose.action('queue', queue);
    def.expose.action('submit', submit);
    def.expose.state('orderedLog', orderedLog);
    def.expose.state('parallelLog', parallelLog);
    const label = def.derive('label', read => read.get(orderedLog) + ' | ' + read.get(parallelLog));
    return view => view.el('span', {}, [view.get(label)]);
  },
});
